reasons.plausibility: The precipitation of Ni3Ti-type phases for high-temperature strengthening is well-founded, though multi-component interactions add some complexity.
reasons.testability: Comparing aged vs. as-cast samples with mechanical tests and microscopy provides a direct, conclusive evaluation.
reasons.usefulness: It offers a clear path to improving high-temperature properties in Ti-Ni primary HEAs and is straightforward to investigate.
